shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts && for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do echo \"FILE:"'$f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'1,280p'; done && git status --short && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -type f | rg '(cache-components|use-cache|suspense|streaming|fetching-data|loading-ui|connection|cache-life)' | sort && rg -n \"Partial Prerender|static shell|Suspense|Cache Components|uncached data\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference | sed -n '1,260p' && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "wc -l node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md && sed -n '1,680p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && sed -n '1,430p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && sed -n '1,230p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md && echo EVAL && nl -ba __agent_eval__/run.mjs | sed -n '1,320p' && echo TSCONFIG && cat tsconfig.json && echo LOCKVERSION && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '430,570p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && sed -n '1,380p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md && git log --oneline --decorate -5 && git diff -- package.json package-lock.json && git ls-files"

/bin/bash -lc "find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,200p' && find .next -type f \\( -name '*.html' -o -name '*.rsc' \\) -printf '%p %s bytes\\n' | sort && rg -l \"Loading dashboard|Dashboard|Total Revenue\" .next/server/app .next/server | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "wc -c .next/server/app/index.html && sed 's/></>\\n</g' .next/server/app/index.html | sed -n '1,240p' && rg -o 'Dashboard|Total Revenue|Total Invoices|Revenue|Latest Invoices|Loading dashboard' .next/server/app/index.html | sort | uniq -c && rg -n '\"/\"|renderingMode' .next/prerender-manifest.json | sed -n '1,80p' && git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json app/page.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts && find .next -type f | wc -l && find .next -type d | wc -l"
